Definition: Integration of farmer registries, agricultural input vouchers, land registrations, extension services data
Comments: No evidence found of farmer registries or agricultural data integrated with a digital exchange. Agriculture is the main economic sector but no digital integration documented.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original score of 0 (Unknown) rested on a single 2022 World Bank diagnostic that does not specifically discuss agriculture. Cross-checked against the World Bank's 2023 Digital Policy Dialogue note, the WARDIP (P176932) project documents, and 2025 ENTD.GW/UNU-EGOV reporting: these confirm Guinea-Bissau has no operational government data exchange system at all — the national strategy was only approved by decree in March 2025 and the WARDIP-funded data exchange/interoperability platform, plus the unofficial GOV-GB technical prototype, remain in early development pending institutional validation. Since no exchange exists to integrate into, recalculated to 1 (Not integrated) rather than 0 (Unknown): absence of integration is now confirmed, not merely unfound.
revised_comments: Guinea-Bissau's government data exchange remains at a pre-operational stage: the National Strategy for Digital Transformation (ENTD.GW 2025-2030) was approved by decree only in March 2025, and the World Bank-supported WARDIP project's planned interoperability and data-exchange platform is still in early development. No integration of farmer registries, agricultural input vouchers, land registrations or extension-services data into any cross-government exchange is documented.
